AV3.name: McDonald's Airtight V3: the step standard (Spec 122/124/132 path); no exception paths; calcs as data, switches, tests first

also.text: Fold Airtight V3 + the 11 cards into the two queues

also.text: through the governing process (MCINC, McProof, Airtight V3, McBylaws), grounded
also.quote: through the governing process (MCINC, McProof, Airtight V3, McBylaws), grounded

BYL.name: McBylaws process: by-law step conversion; queue row first; no code names a zone, scenario or regulation id (M-61)
BYL.quote: McBylaws is the conversion of the by-law step under Spec 122/124 and the Spec 132 handbook

also.text: No code names a zone, a scenario or a regulation id
also.quote: No code names a zone, a scenario or a regulation id

RDG.name: Every reading we made ourselves carries a confidence and an evidence pointer (M-481)
RDG.quote: Each reading row of the switchboard carries a confidence (high, medium, medium-low or low) and an evidence pointer

also.text: Every reading we made ourselves that the by-law text does not settle beyond doubt
also.quote: Every reading we made ourselves that the by-law text does not settle beyond doubt

DDV.name: Data-driven validation: test readings against permits, CoA and past research before asking the operator (operator 2026-10-31)
DDV.quote: Validate by-law readings with permit/CoA data and past research before asking the operator to judge

MCP.name: McProof: scope and answer key first, hand-derived from the by-law text; disputed items walked one at a time (Spec 08 11.8 MCINC-1)

MAP.name: McIncrement impact map measured on the current origin tip (MCINC-2) and one decision list (MCINC-3)
MAP.quote: One impact map, measured on the current origin tip

also.text: One decision list. Every ruling the map needs goes to the operator at once
also.quote: One decision list. Every ruling the map needs goes to the operator at once

BLD.name: Build on the tip: red tests first, then code, through the real hooks (MCINC-4)
BLD.quote: Build on the tip. Red tests first, then the code, through the real hooks.

HS.name: Hooks plus the full suite on the current origin tip before anything is called ready (MCINC-4)
HS.quote: The full suite runs on the current origin tip before

NIGHT.name: At most one Layer 2 night per increment; close only when green in the loop (MCINC-5, MCINC-6)
NIGHT.quote: At most one Layer 2 night per increment

also.text: Close. The increment is green in the loop
also.quote: Close. The increment is green in the loop

RH.name: Rehearse every DB job on the local test stack, with the real hooks, before the go (MCINC-7; Spec 137 rule 9)
RH.quote: Rehearse every DB job before the go

also.text: Every DB job is rehearsed on the local test stack first (MCINC-7: the real commit hooks run on the rehearsal), then runs under the operator's go
also.quote: Every DB job is rehearsed on the local test stack first (MCINC-7: the real commit hooks run on the rehearsal), then runs under the operator's go

GO.name: Operator-typed GO on dev, one DB job at a time
GO.quote: Typed GOs on dev, one at a time (Spec 137 rule 9)

also.text: The DB writer is ONE lane, runs on an operator go, and holds the DB lock
also.quote: The DB writer is ONE lane, runs on an operator go, and holds the DB lock

ID.name: Claim every MF, FE, MB, migration, prereg round, D and M number in the ID ledger before use (MCINC-8)

PUSH.name: Pushes are the operator only: own terminal y, one y and one suite per push; one push per landing set
PUSH.quote: Every push needs your own terminal y (pre-push gate fails without a tty)

STAT.name: One status line per row, replaced in the same commit as the work (Spec 137 rules 1 and 3)
STAT.quote: Every row has ONE status line, REPLACED when the status changes, never appended.

also.text: The status line changes in the same commit as the work
also.quote: The status line changes in the same commit as the work

DN.name: A ruling enters its row as a verbatim dated note, prior text kept (M-246; Spec 137 rule 10)
DN.quote: The operator's words are copied exactly, with the date, the row id and the queue, and the prior row text is kept.

FIT.name: Design-fit gate: every stored or built value maps to a designed McFrontend element or a named supporting function; every designed number bound, served, populated
FIT.quote: DESIGN FIT (seat X, operator 2026-11-17, mandatory in every research, optimisation and build-pass panel)

also.text: report-v2.decl.json is generated from the catalogue
also.quote: report-v2.decl.json is generated from the catalogue

PAN.name: Panel lenses on every plan item: compliance, grounding, reality, options, regression, integration, surrounding work, then final check
PAN.quote: The seven lenses below on every plan item, in subject groups

also.text: FINAL CHECK (seat F, last, before anything reaches the operator)
also.quote: FINAL CHECK (seat F, last, before anything reaches the operator)

FIVE.name: Five principles: standardization, observability, scalability, accuracy, understandability; keep it simple; no scope creep
FIVE.quote: standardization, observability, scalability, accuracy, understandability; keep it simple; no scope creep

SC.name: Simplicity guard: a task is added only if it fills one of the nine slice parts or one supporting function, with a source

STO.name: McStorage rulings ST-1..ST-8: headline record per (parcel, option); detail on demand; long form for bounded cohorts only
